context: Two cafe friends compare reading and tech weekend ideas
purpose: Teach: コンポーネント/スパム/クリップ/新潮/女神/アリス/隼/プラグ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新潮の今月の特集、読んだ？「現代の女神たち」って題のやつ。
lines.en: Did you read this month's Shincho? The feature — 'Modern Goddesses'?
lines.style: Casual, warm curiosity. Slight upturn at the mention of the title, like she's genuinely interested in Mei's take. Natural pause before the title, as if remembering it. Opens a conversation, not delivering information.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 読んだ！アリスっていう若手女優のインタビュー、すごく良かった。
lines.en: I did! There was this interview with a young actress, Alice — it was really good.
lines.style: Soft genuine enthusiasm. Leans forward slightly with the compliment. No performance — just sharing something that landed with her. Warm and inviting, like she wants Aoi to feel the same.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うちの店、Wi-Fiのプラグ抜けてて、お客さんがスパム警告ばっか見てたって。
lines.en: Our Wi-Fi's been acting up — the plug came loose. Customers were just seeing spam warnings all day.
lines.style: Slightly self-conscious, a little rueful. Acknowledges the inconvenience without dwelling. Matter-of-fact about the problem, but with an undertone of 'this is frustrating.' Quick, like she's moving past the embarrassment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ルーターのコンポーネント、古くなってない?買い替え時かも。
lines.en: The router's probably getting old. Might be time to replace it.
lines.style: Practical and steady. Not lecturing — offering a simple solution like someone who notices problems and thinks about fixes. Supportive tone, not critical.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。客足が隼の如く速く戻ってくるか不安。
lines.en: Yeah. I just hope customers come back as quickly as they left.
lines.style: Light self-deprecating humor masking real concern. Gentle smile in the voice. The falcon line lands as wry understatement, not forced. A little uncertain but trying to stay upbeat.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 動画クリップで店内紹介すれば、また人来るって。
lines.en: You should make a quick video of the cafe. Show people what they're missing — they'll come back.
lines.style: Encouraging and grounded. Not pushy, just offering something concrete she believes will work. Gentle confidence. Like she's thought about this and wants Aoi to feel better.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: なるほど。週末撮影、付き合ってくれる？
lines.en: That's a good idea. Will you help me film this weekend?
lines.style: Warm and direct. A real request, not a throw-away. Grateful undertone — she's asking because she wants Mei there, not just hands. Slight lift at the end, hopeful.
